features.title: Announcements (create + share audience, manage/remove)
Layout variants — 3 switchable UX shells (Classic sidebar / Raga top-nav / Studio icon-rail) for design-direction review
features.evidence: frontend/src/components/layout/portal-chrome.tsx dispatches to shells/{classic,raga,studio}-shell.tsx by the active variant on <html data-theme>; each shell is a distinct information architecture (persistent left sidebar / horizontal top-nav with sargam ribbon + centred editorial column / floating translucent icon-rail + Cmd-K command palette), not a recolour. Palette+type per variant in globals.css :root[data-theme] blocks (Classic MKSM-red serif / Raga night-indigo+marigold Fraunces / Studio Apple-blue Inter). Switcher: frontend/src/components/layout/layout-switcher.tsx; variant model + no-FOUC pre-paint script + isThemeId guard: frontend/src/config/theme.ts (tested, frontend/src/config/theme.test.ts). Built with apple-design (Studio) + frontend-design/redesign-skill (top-nav over sidebar; night-raga palette grounded in the subject, not the terracotta-cream default). Verified in-browser: all 3 shells render across student/admin + login, switch persists via localStorage, Cmd-K filters+navigates, mobile drawers, clean console, 34 tests + build green. Accepted tradeoff: dispatcher renders Classic on SSR/first paint then swaps to the stored shell after mount (colors are correct instantly via the pre-paint script; nav structure reflows once for non-classic viewers) — an SSR-inlined variant (e.g. cookie) would remove the reflow in M2.

features.title: Client feedback round 2 — progress consistency, announcement edit/rich-text/popup, MKSM personality on favored shells
features.evidence: 1) Progress consistency (student): the ongoing weekly batch class showed 100% on Overview but 62% under My Classes. Extracted the rule to a pure helper frontend/src/domain/course.ts:displayProgress (ongoing→100%, else raw fraction), now the single source for both frontend/src/app/student/overview/page.tsx and frontend/src/app/student/courses/page.tsx so they cannot drift again. Tested frontend/src/domain/course.test.ts (3 tests). Verified in-browser: My Classes now reads 100%. 2) Announcements Edit (admin): frontend/src/app/admin/announcements/manage-list.tsx gained an Edit button beside Remove, opening an in-place edit dialog (title+body) that updates the item without delete-and-recreate (prototype: local state). 3) Rich text + read popup (admin): announcement text supports **bold** and *italic* via a pure, injection-safe parser frontend/src/domain/rich-text.ts (tokens rendered as React children by frontend/src/components/ui/rich-text.tsx — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no HTML sink) tested frontend/src/domain/rich-text.test.ts (7 tests, incl. a <script> stays-literal case). The Manage list now shows title + plain-text preview only; clicking the title opens the full formatted body in a dialog (frontend/src/components/ui/modal.tsx — Escape/backdrop close, role=dialog). Format hint added to the create + edit forms; student Announcements panel renders the same formatting. Demo markers added to two admin mock announcements. 4) MKSM personality (theme feedback, favored shells Classic+Raga): a 'sur rekha' signature — a sam-marked accent rule under every page title (frontend/src/components/layout/page-header.tsx + .mksm-sur-rule in globals.css), token-tinted per theme (Classic red→saffron, Raga saffron→indigo), hidden on Studio to keep it minimal; plus font-optical-sizing + size-specific display tracking on the editorial serifs. Verified in-browser on Classic and Raga. Presented as a first creative pass for review.
